'''Darth Vax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="SpeciesAndDate" /> who served on the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During her time and later she was concidred as a prominent member of the [[Dark Council]]. Vax had a [[Reproduction/Legends|son]], who succeeded his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] on the Dark Council after Vax's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Codex" /> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the war,<ref name="SpeciesAndDate" /> and her son took on the title [[Darth Arrid]]. However, Vax's will enabled to her to persist as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], and she began to manipulate her son, using him as a mouthpiece to continue her rule from beyond the grave&mdash;a deception that took the other Dark Council members four years to discover.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vax was mentioned in the "Force Ghost" Codex entry in Chapter XII of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
